study_strategy.warning: Central Texas Silphium names have shifted. Old S. integrifolium var. asperrimum and var. radulum labels should not be reassigned automatically under modern species concepts.

quick_split: S. albiflorum — white ray flowers + rough often deeply divided leaves; project PASS (Travis, Burnet, Mason).
S. radula — broad rough/scabrous leaves and stems + yellow heads; project PASS (Hays, Williamson, Kerr).
S. laciniatum — huge deeply pinnatifid compass leaves + yellow heads; project RANGE HOLD because known Hays occurrence is introduced.
S. integrifolium — broad entire leaves + yellow heads; taxonomy/range HOLD because historical Central Texas varietal names do not map cleanly to current species concepts.
